description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Amplify UI Builder service in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, exporting, and updating components, forms, themes, and managing tokens and metadata related to the service.

classes.name: AmplifyUIBuilderClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for AWS Amplify UI Builder, providing methods to interact with the service via AWS SDK.

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description: Creates a new UI component using AWS Amplify UI Builder.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Creates a new form resource in the Amplify UI Builder.

methods.name: createTheme
methods.description: Creates a new theme resource for the Amplify UI Builder.

methods.name: deleteComponent
methods.description: Deletes a specified component.

methods.name: deleteForm
methods.description: Deletes a specified form.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Deletes a specified theme.

methods.name: exchangeCodeForToken
methods.description: Exchanges an authorization code for an access token.

methods.name: exportComponents
methods.description: Exports components from the UI Builder.

methods.name: exportForms
methods.description: Exports forms from the UI Builder.

methods.name: exportThemes
methods.description: Exports themes from the UI Builder.

methods.name: getCodegenJob
methods.description: Retrieves details of a code generation job.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific component.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific form.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Gets metadata related to the service.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific theme.

methods.name: listCodegenJobs
methods.description: Lists code generation jobs.

methods.name: listComponents
methods.description: Lists available components.

methods.name: listForms
methods.description: Lists available forms.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listThemes
methods.description: Lists available themes.

methods.name: putMetadataFlag
methods.description: Updates metadata flags.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the authentication token.

methods.name: startCodegenJob
methods.description: Starts a new code generation job.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateComponent
methods.description: Updates an existing component.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates an existing form.

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Updates an existing theme.
